rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for an orchestra of instrumentalists.

example.english: When I was little, I often went with my family to hear an orchestra perform.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣成日跟屋企人去聽管弦樂團演奏。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 gan1 uk1 kei2 jan4 heoi3 teng1 gun2 jin4 ngok6 tyun4 jin2 zau3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a symphony orchestra.

example.english: The symphony orchestra is performing at the Cultural Centre tonight.
example.traditional: 今晚交響樂團喺文化中心演出。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 gaau1 hoeng2 ngok6 tyun4 hai2 man4 faa3 zung1 sam1 jin2 ceot1

rows.note: Use this for an orchestra made up specifically of string instruments.

example.english: The school invited a string orchestra to perform at the graduation ceremony.
example.traditional: 學校請咗弦樂團喺畢業禮演奏。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 ceng2 zo2 jin4 ngok6 tyun4 hai2 bat1 jip6 lai5 jin2 zau3
